Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the Planner correctly identified from the WebSurfer results that the chapel belongs to the Royal Australian Navy (RAN). However, the Planner erroneously concluded that the Royal Australian Navy is a branch of the "British Armed Forces (BAF)." The Royal Australian Navy is actually the naval branch of the **Australian Defence Force**. This is a fundamental factual error regarding the organization of modern military forces, as the Australian Defence Force was established in 1901 as part of the federation of Australia, separate from the British Armed Forces (which dissolved as a unified entity after the creation of independent Commonwealth forces).
